body.name: Observed-experiment estimator class
body.construction:
Set \(\mathcal O_{n,m}=\sigma(A,Y,p)\) and
\[
 \mathfrak E_{n,m}=\{\widetilde U:\widetilde U\text{ is }\mathcal O_{n,m}\text{-measurable and }\widetilde U\in\mathbb O_{n,r}\}.
\]
The dimensions, the structural envelopes, and the fixed singular-vector tie rule are nonrandom inputs; measurability of an \(\mathbb O_{n,r}\)-valued map is with respect to the Borel sigma-field inherited from \(\mathbb R^{n\times r}\).
inputs: The observed assignments, outcomes, recorded propensities, and fixed nonrandom model inputs.
